answer: In a decentralized agent economy, resisting Sybil attacks requires anchoring digital identities to provable cryptographic friction. Imagine an automated port or a digital wharf where every incoming agent must lock capital or historical reputation into an immutable ledger, secured by robust onyx cryptographic hashing. This ensures a strict one-to-one mapping between economic weight and agency. Without this cryptographic thread connecting verified stake to compute, malicious actors could endlessly spin up fake identities to manipulate consensus.
